title: A phone call, a million files: Uber Freight breach exposes logistics’ identity security gap
content:
In a nutshell: the Helix extortion group claims to have taken nearly a million documents from one of North America’s largest managed-transportation platforms, using tactics no more sophisticated than impersonating an IT helpdesk.
It is a grim irony that a company built on digitizing freight brokerage may have been compromised by one of the oldest tricks in cybercrime: a phone call.
